scope: Stage 2 of the 1st development plan: connect NBCP to the common model. NBCP SpinModel on the primitive triangular lattice with published parameter sets, candidate magnetic structures as SpinState, and a SpinSystem bridge in both directions. Existing computational code unchanged.

added.model/nbcp/model.py: LATTICE, SUPERCELLS, PARAMETER_SETS (woodland2025, park2026_fig4), build_model, build_published_model, legacy_cells, candidate_state

changed.code-space/spintoolkit/system/spin_syste: Coupling/add_coupling docstrings: d = r_i - r_j, partner at r_i - d (D13); no code change
changed.code-space/tests/test_models/test_nbcp.p: test_old_example_imports_preserve_builder_interface now lists the six legacy builder names explicitly instead of iterating model.nbcp.__all__, which grew with the stage-2 API

d13_confirmation.method: bosonic H(k) at 4 k-points from the existing LSWTHamiltonian, converted model+state vs legacy one_msl..four_msl builders, sites matched by position modulo the magnetic lattice
d13_confirmation.cases: 4 cells x 5 parameter families (xxz, nn_soc, nn_nnn_soc, dm, zero_exchange) with field (0.03, -0.04, 0.2) meV, angles with theta in (0, pi)
d13_confirmation.negative_control: storing d = r_target - r_source changes Three MSL H(k) by more than 1e-3
d13_confirmation.round_trip: legacy SpinSystem -> from_spin_system -> to_spin_system: max |dH| 1.7e-17 over the same 20 cases
d13_confirmation.row_convention: confirms that the BdG row index is the creation-operator side (a^dagger_source a_target -> exp(+i k.Delta))

gauge_invariant_checks: for angles outside the canonical range (linspace(-1.1, 2.3)), classical energy (1e-14) and E_qm on N = 3 (1e-12) agree for all 20 cases; off-diagonal H(k) elements differ there only by the local-frame gauge
lattice: M @ A equals the legacy lattice vectors for all four cells: Two [[1,1],[1,-1]], Three [[2,1],[1,2]], Four [[2,0],[0,2]] on A = [[1/2, sqrt3/2], [1/2, -sqrt3/2]]

parameter_sets.woodland2025: arXiv:2505.06398 Table 1: Jz 0.1225(10), Jxy 0.0779(7) meV, g_c 4.716(7), g_ab 4.200(7); g = diag(g_ab, g_ab, g_c); dB offset not a model parameter
